messages:
zoe (support): heads up — tenant 'lighthouse' reporting hourly usage delayed by ~4 hours on the console. customer says dashboards show zeros for recent 04:00-08:00 window. filing as P1 for customer SLA impact.

maya (support): adding logs from customer and usage ids — they hit API fine but console shows stale aggregates. customer used the dataset during the window and has activity.

sam (eng-data): can you paste a couple tenant ids and request ids? also which pipeline (hourly-rollup vs realtime-ingest)?

zoe (support): tenant: tenant_lighthouse_42, example request id: req_7f9a2c. looks like hourly-rollup.

eli (eng-sre): I just checked the metrics — hourly-rollup consumer group lag spiked at 03:58 and never recovered. consumer offset stuck on partition 12. heartbeat for worker 'etl-rollup-03' stopped at 04:05.

sam (eng-data): interesting — we deployed an ORM migration last night that renamed usage->usage_count in events table. ETL read path expects old column unless we used the new preflight. could be schema drift causing row parse errors and consumer to pause.

ryan (eng-runtime): +1. If the ETL encounters a schema exception we currently mark the message as poisoned and the consumer pauses for backoff. Ill check logs for exceptions.

eli (eng-sre): log tail from etl-rollup-03 (excerpt):
```
2026-03-17T04:02:11Z ERROR com.redwood.etl.Parser - SchemaMismatchError: missing column 'usage' in row id f2b3c4
2026-03-17T04:02:11Z WARN  com.redwood.queue - pausing consumer partition=12 for backoff
2026-03-17T04:02:11Z INFO  com.redwood.lifecycle - heartbeat stopped for worker=etl-rollup-03
```

sam (eng-data): yup that's the one. migration renamed usage->usage_count and our parser only looks for "usage" key. That will cause the consumer to hit the bad row and pause. explains the 4h delay.

maya (support): how many tenants affected? only tenants migrated to new schema?

sam (eng-data): quick grep shows ~7 tenants wrote rows with new schema in that window. others continued with old schema. impacted tenants list: tenant_lighthouse_42, tenant_orchid_7, tenant-halo.

arjun (product): flagged as high priority — customers in finance vertical affected. need ETA to restore dashboards and mitigation to prevent recurrence.

ryan (eng-runtime): short-term fix: restart consumer with a tolerant parser flag to skip schema-check failures, and kick a targeted backfill for the 03:00-09:00 window for the affected tenants. long-term: we should make parser backward-compatible and add schema migration gating so producers can't write until consumers are compatible.

eli (eng-sre): I can restart etl-rollup-03 now in maintenance mode. performing a rolling restart and enabling "skip-poisoned" flag on the consumer group.

deploy-bot: deploy started by eli — etl-rollup-03 restart (flags: skip_poisoned=true) — job 5527 — status: running. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

zoe (support): telling customer were investigating, will update in <30m after restart.

eli (eng-sre): restart complete. consumer rejoined at 04:38, lag draining. metrics show hourly-rollup processed backlog from 04:40 -> 05:12, writes to rollup table resumed.

sam (eng-data): triggered targeted backfill for tenant_lighthouse_42 and tenant_orchid_7 for 03:00-09:00 window. job id: backfill-801. running through job-runner.

maya (support): customer notified — they see numbers starting to appear, still catching up. asked them to refresh in 20m and confirm. :thumbsup:

arjun (product): next steps: (1) create a migration playbook that requires consumer compatibility check before DB migration, (2) add schema-tolerant parsing as default, (3) instrument a fail-open mode so consumers skip malformed rows and emit a metric (not pause).

sam (eng-data): filing infra ticket and PR to add tolerant parser + unit tests. will also add an alert for "consumer-heartbeat-stopped" so ops get paged earlier.

eli (eng-sre): creating incident follow-up doc with timeline and remediation steps; will attach logs and restart commands used.

zoe (support): closing loop — customer confirmed dashboards updating at 05:05 and numbers match backend events. marking incident resolved for now, but leaving backfill/PR tasks open.

maya (support): adding customer notes and billing hold check (no spikes).

sam (eng-data): estimate for PR -> canary -> prod: 2 days. backfill will finish in ~30m.

ryan (eng-runtime): logging the change to consumer config and adding canary gating on schema mismatch metric.

eli (eng-sre): incident resolved. incident ID: INC-2026-0317-09. follow-ups assigned. :tada:
